activity_summary: You stood in the porch with Mistress Ansell and Alse after a long sermon. She kept the one hawthorn bough she had allowed on May Day, and she would not have it improved. Alse had not brought a second. You did not count the heads of the sermon. The book under your cloak waited for the stair.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Kept the custom at one bough, and ended the porch.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Said she had not brought a second bough.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Left the bough unimproved, and saved the book for the stair.

facets.activity: Left the one bough as it was
